name: Catch the Planets
description: On the loose! Planets have been spotted. Chase them down and collect as much data as you can!
how_to_play: Move around and catch all the planets before time runs out.

name: Bounty Hunters Aboard!
description: Aliens are after the same target as you! Stay ahead of them or risk being left behind.
how_to_play: Tap on the aliens until none remains and before time runs out

name: Dodging Asteroids
description: Asteroids inbound! Pilot your ship through the deadly field of space rocks.
how_to_play: Dodge the asteroids and survive until the timer ends.

name: Sequence Reset
description: Your ship needs recalibration! Remember the pattern and enter it correctly.
how_to_play: Watch the sequence, then repeat it in the correct order.

name: Lever Fixer
description: Your ship was damaged in the crash! Adjust the controls and get everything working again.
how_to_play: Flip the levers to match the required code.

name: Fuel Gauge Fanatic
description: Running low on fuel! Refill the tank to the target amount.
how_to_play: Use the lever to increase fuel level until it matches the marker.

name: Meteor Shower
description: A meteor shower is approaching! Protect your ship from incoming space debris.
how_to_play: Move out of the way and avoid getting hit by meteors.

name: Here to Earth, Are You There?!
description: Your only hope is Earth. Point the antenna and send a distress signal!
how_to_play: Rotate the antenna toward Earth and transmit the signal.

name: Earth Found!
description: The satellite has gone rogue! Spot Earth and stop the scanner before it moves on.
how_to_play: Find Earth and press the stop button as quickly as possible.

name: Lights Out!
description: The power's out! Find the switch before everything goes dark for good.
how_to_play: Search the area and turn the lights back on.

name: Ore Sorting, More Smelting!
description: Time to make some profit! Sort valuable ore from worthless stone.
how_to_play: Collect all ore and avoid picking up rocks.

name: Hammer-Crazed Madness!
description: Precision is everything! Strike the ore with just the right amount of force.
how_to_play: Charge your hammer and release at the correct power level.

name: Distress disguise!
description: The aliens are after you! Quick! Make a disguise now!
how_to_play: Change the visual of the alien to match the alien in the box on the top left.
